Burqa-Clad Women Steal Gold Necklace from Telangana Jewellery Shop

Two women, disguised in burqas, stole a gold necklace weighing approximately 70 grams from a jewellery shop in Zahirabad town, Telangana, on Sunday. They posed as customers before committing the theft. The incident was captured on the shop's security cameras.
